text:
Assistant A is better. It gives a concrete, organized list of plausible reasons (working at the hospital, caregiving, volunteering, clinical trials, therapy, medical training) and ends by noting what information would narrow it down. Its weakest point is item 6: dialysis or regular infusions don't fit someone described as very healthy, so that example is a stretch.

Assistant B is vague. Its suggestions (check-ups, monitoring, therapy) conflict with the premise that Thomas is very healthy, and it offers little detail. It does acknowledge the missing context, but it doesn't give the user much to work with.

[[A]]
